tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

Before submitting e-Tender, Tenderers are requested in their own interest to inspect the item at KSDL offered for disposal on As is where is Basis in person and satisfy them self before submitting e-tender. Further, tenderers are advised to carefully go through the Terms & Conditions of the tender and instructions to the tenderers.
Bidders must upload site inspection report obtained from AM(Stores)
The quantity mentioned is approximate. The actual quantity will be determined at the time of lifting the material, and payment shall be made based on the quantity actually lifted.
For any clarification please contact AM (Stores)- 080-22164901
All other terms and conditions are as per uploaded bid documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Has the tenderer lifted any Scrap from KSDL or any other similar Company if so - Upload work order/Invoice. If not your bid is liable for rejection.
Technical bid format is to be filled and uploaded.
Acceptance of all Terms and Conditions in tenderer letter head with seal and signature
Bidders must upload site inspection report obtained from AM(Stores).

itemList.specifications: As per tender document:Bidder has to quote the amount in Rs (IAT) per kg
